scores.category: Memorability (functional: onboarding, empty states, data moments, signature detail)
scores.evidence: Seven-step spotlight tutorial on real UI including 'Where the numbers go' on a live field (tour-5-1440.png), keyboard operable and replayable; baseline band is a signature detail found only here; per-indicator ring and the chamfered key family now give the app an instrument-panel identity that a squinting viewer would not take for an admin template (today-dark-1440.png). Gaps: the save moment (ring sweep, tile stagger) was verified only as a static frame; empty states are a single line with an icon, still no designed moment; Settings is a plain stack of radio rows (settings-dark-1440.png).

Contrast passes on every rendered node in both themes; 20/20 dark, 23/23 light token pairs; crew tabs are a roving tablist with accessible names 'Commander, Act now'; focus ring follows the cut; full check-in in 6 actions at three widths; all primary actions 56px, nav and steppers 48px. Defects: the Settings range thumb is 22px (settings.css:21) on a glove tablet; the Alerts demo-time checkbox is a small box and its label is the only extended target.

uxWeighting: Product goal 'easy and quick for astronauts' is met: one answer and one button on Today, flagged tiles grouped first, a prefilled five-step check-in with cue cards saved in 6 keyboard actions, 56px primary and 48px everything-else targets, a 7-step tutorial that now says where numbers go. What still costs time: Today on a phone buries the flagged tiles under a full-height body map, Alerts is a long page whose form sits last, and a few form controls (radio, range, file) are not the same family as the keys.
